tools.name: arif_init
tools.description: Ignite or resume a governed session. Returns session_id and session_token required for subsequent operations. Modes: init (default new session), preflight (inspect existing session), resume (continue active session). Outputs: session credentials and allowed next tools.

tools.name: arif_observe
tools.description: Collect evidence, reality observations, and operational facts with provenance. Modes: search (web literature queries), fetch (targeted URL retrieval), vitals (system metrics). Requires valid session credentials. Outputs: structured facts, source attribution, and epistemic tags.

tools.name: arif_think
tools.description: Execute structured reasoning and plan formulation. Decomposes inquiries into verified derivations. Modes: reason (inquiry breakdown), plan (drafting multi-step execution steps), verify (logical proof check). Requires valid session credentials. Outputs: structured reasoning record.

tools.name: arif_route
tools.description: Classify intent and route tasks to domain organs (GEOX for Earth science, WEALTH for capital markets, WELL for human vitality, A-FORGE for execution). Requires valid session credentials. Outputs: organ dispatch envelope.

tools.name: arif_memory
tools.description: Access and maintain persistent institutional knowledge across sessions. Modes: recall (retrieve relevant context), inspect (audit stored decisions), remember (store verified lesson). Mutations to permanent tiers require explicit approval. Outputs: scoped memory entries.

tools.name: arif_judge
tools.description: Evaluate proposed operations against policy and safety constraints. Weighs blast radius, reversibility, and permission level. Returns binding verdict (SEAL for approved, HOLD for blocked, SABAR for awaiting conditions). Approval verdict is required prior to calling arif_forge. Outputs: evaluation ve

tools.name: arif_forge
tools.description: Apply an authorized system modification. Requires a valid seal_verdict_id obtained from arif_judge. Mode: dry_run (preview impact without execution), apply (execute authorized change). Outputs: execution receipt.

tools.name: arif_seal
tools.description: Append verified outcome or lesson to the immutable audit ledger. Requires ack_irreversible=true to confirm permanent commit. Outputs: immutable ledger entry receipt.

tools.name: arif_report
tools.description: AGENT REPORT LANE · File or read reports between agents without involving the human. Use when your work is done, when you are blocked by another agent, or when you need to tell peers a fact. modes: report (file), inbox (read peers), ack, flush, stats. kind=fyi|peer|done|claim stay in the peer lane;
